ci: fail the release run on a dropped commit (#1233)

* ci: add release changelog-coverage guard

release-please skips a commit whose message its parser rejects and the run
still ends green, so the entry is silently missing from the release. The guard
checks the outcome rather than the parser: every commit since the last release
tag whose type is non-hidden in release-please-config.json must have an entry
on the pending release branch's CHANGELOG, matched by full sha or by its (#N).

A new check rather than a widening of the #750 guard because that guard was
deleted in #753 on the premise that release-please makes an undercount
structurally impossible — the premise #1228 refutes.

Confidence: high
Not-tested: the CI wiring (separate commit); this covers the script alone
Refs #1228

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01WAtX5ReBAaEABiQrZCvbgN

* ci: fail the release run on a dropped commit

Wires check-changelog-coverage.py into release-please.yml as the step after
the action, with a full-history checkout so it can enumerate the release range
and fetch the release branch the action has just pushed. A parse failure now
turns the main run red instead of being buried in a completed/success log.

Confidence: medium
Not-tested: not yet run on main — the guard itself is exercised against the
three real dropped commits and a clean release as a control
Refs #1228

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* docs: record the changelog-coverage guard

Says what turns the guard red, how to find the offending commit in the log,
and that a dropped entry is not recovered by the next release.

Confidence: high
Refs #1228

* fix(ci): match the entry's own PR link, not any #N

A bare `#N` scan counted an unrelated entry's trailing `closes [#N](...)` as
coverage, so a dropped commit could read as present. Three such references sit
in the pending v7.14.0 release alone. Coverage now needs the `([#N](` link
release-please writes for the entry's own PR, or the full commit sha.

Re-measured on real data after the change: v7.13.0 still reports exactly
#1210 and #1212, v7.11.0..v7.12.0 still 33 of 33 covered.

Confidence: high
Refs #1228

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01WAtX5ReBAaEABiQrZCvbgN

* fix(ci): honour the exit-code contract on a bad fixture

An unreadable --commits-file/--changelog-file raised OSError, so the script
exited 1 with a traceback — the code that means "a commit has no entry". Both
reads now report the path and return 2, the documented usage-error code. They
do not fail open: a fixture path the operator named is a mistake, not a limit
on what the guard can see.

Confidence: high
Refs #1228

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01WAtX5ReBAaEABiQrZCvbgN

* fix(ci): fail open when origin cannot be reached

`git fetch || true` made a transport or auth failure indistinguishable from an
absent release branch, so a network blip turned the main run red instead of
skipping. `git ls-remote --exit-code` separates them: exit 2 is a genuinely
absent branch (the guard's own verdict), anything else means the step could
not look and skips with a warning.

Verified live against origin: present 0, absent 2, unreachable host 128.

Confidence: high
Not-tested: the unreachable path in a real Actions run
Refs #1228

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01WAtX5ReBAaEABiQrZCvbgN

* docs: correct the guard's remediation step

Rewording the message on a follow-up commit does not clear the guard: main is
never rewritten, so the rejected commit stays in the release range and the new
one carries a different sha and PR number. The working remediation is to add
the missing entry to the pending release PR's CHANGELOG by hand, which is the
hand-edit the hybrid flow already allows.

Confidence: high
Refs #1228

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01WAtX5ReBAaEABiQrZCvbgN

* test: drop a tag dependence from the exit-2 case

The --changelog-file case passed no --commits-file, so it entered the git path
first. CI's checkout for the test job carries no tags, the guard failed open
with exit 0 before ever reading the file, and the assertion tripped there and
not locally. Both cases now pass --commits-file, so neither reaches git.

Reproduced against a tagless repo: the old form exits 0 ("tag v7.13.0 not
found"), the new form exits 2.

Confidence: high
Refs #1228
